Description:
The Espec E-series temperature and climate chambers are mainly used for conducting temperature and climate tests on large and often heavy products, or if many small products need to be tested at the same time. Espec’s smallest walk-in climate chamber features a 2-m² floor surface, whereas the floor surface of the largest model exceeds 25 m². The different models can also be configured based on temperature range (-40 °C/-30 °C/-10 °C to +80 °C), relative humidity, and the cooling capacity needed.
By default, the Espec climate chambers feature a user-friendly 10.4-inch program controller from which the climate chamber can be monitored, programmed and controlled. Thanks to the integrated Ethernet port, remote communication is also possible.
The many possibilities and options make the Espec climate chamber excellently suited to a wide range of applications in the automotive, electronics, energy, aviation and packaging industries.
